note: De Surinaamsche Bank's information sheet (April 2025): its Classic credit card, in US dollars, costs 50 dollars a year in membership, and a balance on which only the minimum is paid bears 1¼% in finance charges, written as a month's rate, the statement being monthly; paying in full costs nothing.
